entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I bought these cycling shoes a while ago, and I'm just so lost with the website. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, I don't know. They just... they gave me terrible blisters the one time I wore them. And the cleats feel strange. I tried reading the policy online, but I didn't understand it. I just want to send them back. Can't you just help me?
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that definitely doesn't sound comfortable. I can absolutely help you. Let me just check the policy for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's VF987654.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the mountain bike shoes, delivered 53 days ago. Just one moment while I confirm the return eligibility.
Alright, I've checked our system. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. So yes, we can definitely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can get a full refund?

That's correct. Once we receive the cycling shoes, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file right now. Do you have access to a printer?
Yes, I do. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
